title: Finans Portali financial report export timing out for large date ranges
description: The quarterly financial summary report export to PDF is timing out when running for a full quarter. Monthly reports work fine (complete in about 2 minutes). The quarterly report covers 3 months of data. Finance management needs this report for the board presentation tomorrow.

worklogs.description: Report query analysis. The quarterly report uses a SUM/GROUP BY query across 3 months of transaction data without date-range indexes. Full table scan on 450,000 rows.
Added index on the transaction_date column in the transactions table.
Quarterly report now generates in 45 seconds. Previously timing out at 120 seconds.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I ran a query analysis on the quarterly report. The report query is doing a full table scan on the transactions table for the date range filter. The transactions table has 450,000 rows and no index on the transaction_date column. For a monthly report, the full scan takes about 90 seconds - which is under the 2-minute display timeout so it works. For a quarterly report covering 3x more data, the scan takes 4+ minutes and times out. Adding a date column index will fix this. I will add...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Please do it quickly. Board presentation is tomorrow morning.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Index created. Tested the quarterly report - it generated in 42 seconds. Please run the board presentation report now to verify.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Quarterly report generated successfully. PDF looks correct. Board presentation is ready. Thank you for the fast turnaround.

resolutionNote: Transactions table had no index on transaction_date. Monthly reports ran in ~90s (under timeout) but quarterly reports timed out at 4+ minutes. Added index on transaction_date - quarterly report now generates in 42 seconds.

csat.comment: Saved the board presentation. Thank you.
